Proposition
[The Hodge Star in Degree Zero]

↗ prop:hodge-star-pointwise ↗ def:wedge-alternating-forms ↗ def:inner-k-covectors

When $\iota _a=\varnothing $, $0$-covectors are scalars, the degree-zero inner product is multiplication, and $*f=f\, dV$.
Proof

\sketch The empty-index permutation sum has one term, so wedging by a scalar is scalar multiplication and the pointwise star formula is the scalar multiple of the reference volume form.

□
